svg.title: One screen refresh (8 pages over I2C, D1 SDA, D7 SCL), then the UART line on D6
svg.desc: One screen refresh (8 pages over I2C, D1 SDA, D7 SCL), then the UART line on D6. window: 75.0 ms. sample_rate: 4.00 MS/s. d1_min: 0. d1_max: 1. d7_min: 0. d7_max: 1. d6_min: 0. d6_max: 1.
